SessionCookie.name: better-auth.session_token
SessionCookie.description: Official opaque Better Auth cookie in local HTTP. HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, no JWT bearer.

SecureSessionCookie.name: __Secure-better-auth.session_token
SecureSessionCookie.description: Official opaque Better Auth cookie when secureCookies=true; Secure and HttpOnly.

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfToken.description: Session-bound token from GET /v1/session/csrf, required for /v1 mutations.

Cursor.description: Opaque scoped cursor; consumers never interpret its contents.

Percentage.description: Safe scaled integer string, 10^6 units per percentage point.

tombstones.description: Empty in V1: archived products and voided operations are upserts. No financial deletion semantics.
